experiments.scope: 256 organizer-seeded rho values; exact selected 56-round Orchard hash, projected to a closed 7-bit state map; at most 54 projected-map calls per trial. Returned pairs are checked only for the seven low digest bits.
experiments.hypothesis: The selected fixed function shows small-projection cycle collision behavior compatible with the declared ideal-map heuristic; this experiment does not measure the full 254-bit search.

experiments.scope: 256 organizer-seeded rho and full-width start values; twenty sequential exact 56-round Orchard hashes per trial; report the first collision in eight low digest bits only.
experiments.hypothesis: Full-width adaptive trails of the selected target have low-byte output occupancy compatible with a random-map short-trail baseline; this does not measure full-field collisions.
